invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, which is typically non-null after clustering commit actions. A null would indicate a severe failure or design issue.
A clustering instant time should be provided and not null when cluster is invoked, as it identifies the clustering operation context.
HoodieEngineContext is required for all data operations and should not be null at the exit of the cluster method.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata's write status list should never be null, as it represents the result of clustering operations.
The list of WriteStatus should usually be non-empty after performing successful clustering, indicating work was done.
